title: iPhone Duo owners report cracks in Apple’s first foldable handset
author: Dan Milmo
summary: Owners of the new foldable iPhone Duo report cracked screens after it went on general sale globally, and Apple confirmed an issue with a 'small number' of units. Experts said there were too few examples yet to judge whether the problem is more serious. The device retails from $1,999.
